answer: Honest nodes broadcast a signed beacon each round, and peers only count identities whose beacon matches on-chain history. A concrete sybil-resistance protocol: each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work challenge tied to its identity, so forging thousands of fake agents costs real compute and locked capital. An attacker must outspend the network at every summit of accumulated stake, and any valid signal of duplicate work forfeits the bond, making mass impersonation economically irrational.
